name: io.github.dfch/biz-dfch-specmgr
title: SpecMgr
description: An artifact manager for system specifications.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: Install with the 'mcp' extra so the MCP server dependencies (mcp SDK) are available; the base package alone has no MCP support.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_ADR_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Base directory scanned for Architecture Decision Record (.md) files.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_DOCS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Shared base directory root for the document-type domains that do not have their own dedicated directory environment variable (req, uc, tsk, qa, prb, gol, rsk, dec, sop, vcr, sysrs). Each domain's own subdirectory is appended automatically, e.g. docs/req.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_FEAT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Base directory scanned for Feature folders (<base>/<id>/README.md).

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_SIMILARITY_DISABLED
environmentVariables.description: Presence-based opt-out for the semantic-similarity search feature (the find_related and find_similar_text tools): set to any value to disable the feature, so that every call returns a structured unavailable result and the embedding model is never loaded, and to skip the similarity phase of the unified server-startup warmup thread. Unset by default. Its resolved state is reported by the similarity section of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_FEAT_WARMUP_DISABLED
environmentVariables.description: Presence-based opt-out for the feat domain's two background cache-warming phases (frontmatter and full-parse) of the unified server-startup warmup thread: set to any value to skip both phases; when set together with SPECMGR_SIMILARITY_DISABLED, no warmup thread is started at all. Unset by default. Its resolved state is reported by the feat_warmup_disabled field of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_PLANTUML_JAR
environmentVariables.description: Path to a plantuml.jar, one of exactly three PlantUML validation-source selectors (the first one set, in JAR then BIN then URL order, is the only source used; no fall-through, no PATH discovery, no public default; all three unset is the offline structure-only floor). Unset by default. The selected source is reported by the plantuml section of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_PLANTUML_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to an executable speaking the PlantUML CLI contract, one of exactly three PlantUML validation-source selectors (the first one set, in JAR then BIN then URL order, is the only source used; no fall-through, no PATH discovery, no public default; all three unset is the offline structure-only floor). Unset by default. The selected source is reported by the plantuml section of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_PLANTUML_URL
environmentVariables.description: PlantUML server base URL, one of exactly three PlantUML validation-source selectors (the first one set, in JAR then BIN then URL order, is the only source used; no fall-through, no PATH discovery, no public default; all three unset is the offline structure-only floor). Diagram content is only sent to a PlantUML server if this variable is set. Unset by default. The selected source is reported by the plantuml section of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_TESTS_NO_DOTENV
environmentVariables.description: Presence-based test/CI sentinel: set to any value to skip the CLI's module-level default .env load entirely, so the process runs under the CI (source-less) condition whatever the local (gitignored) .env configures; this is what keeps the specmgr coverage-badge pre-commit hook's source-less re-run source-less end-to-end. Unset by default, never set outside test runs.

environmentVariables.name: FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory for the semantic-similarity feature's embedding model (the third-party fastembed backend's own variable, not a SPECMGR_* one): set to a directory to cache the model there; an unset or empty value falls back to the default <tempdir>/fastembed_cache, where <tempdir> is the process's temporary directory (e.g. /tmp on Linux). Unset by default. The resolved directory is reported by the similarity section of the specmgr://config resource.
